verified_claim_families: The API provides one consistent interface across more than 100 England planning and housing datasets.
Coordinate searches return entities whose geometry intersects the supplied point and can be restricted by repeated dataset parameters.
The q parameter accepts a postcode or UPRN; the documentation describes UPRN lookup as more precise than coordinate lookup for registered properties.
Entity responses can include name, dataset, start-date, geometry WKT and point WKT, but absent results do not prove absent constraints because coverage varies.
geometry_entity can reuse an existing entity geometry and geometry_relation supports within, equals, disjoint, intersects, touches, contains, covers, coveredby, overlaps and crosses.
Custom geometry input uses WKT in WGS84 EPSG:4326.
Pagination uses limit and offset and responses expose next, previous, first and last links.
The API has no batch endpoint; large portfolios should use polite per-property requests or bulk downloads.
Bulk downloads provide stable snapshots and are available in CSV, JSON and where applicable GeoJSON and Parquet.
Search filters include entity, reference, CURIE, typology, dataset and organisation entity.
The period parameter distinguishes current from all entries.
Start-date, end-date and entry-date filters have separate year, month, day and match semantics.
field and exclude_field control returned fields, with field taking precedence.
quality can filter entity records by quality classification.
The service is documented as beta, so production consumers must guard against interface change.
